```{ojs}
// Loaded at runtime with a fresh URL so a cached older ctd.js or trade file is never mixed with this page.
ctdlib = import(new URL(`ctd.js?v=${Date.now()}`, document.baseURI).href)
parseDate = ctdlib.parseDate
setup = ctdlib.setup
yieldFromPrice = ctdlib.yieldFromPrice
chartlib = import(new URL(`charts.js?v=${Date.now()}`, document.baseURI).href)
Plotly = require("plotly.js-dist-min@2.35.2")
plot = (data, layout, height) => chartlib.plot(Plotly, data, layout, height)
COLORS = chartlib.COLORS
trades = fetch(`eurex_trades.json?v=${Date.now()}`).then(r => r.json())
baskets = FileAttachment("baskets.json").json()
oiData = FileAttachment("eurex_flow.json").json()
codes = ["DU", "OE", "RX", "UB", "OAT", "BTS", "IK"]
fmt = d3.format(",")
signed = (x, digits = 0) => x == null || isNaN(x) ? "–" : `${x > 0 ? "+" : ""}${x.toFixed(digits)}`
dayLabel = d => `${d.slice(0, 4)}-${d.slice(4, 6)}-${d.slice(6)}`
tile = (label, value, note = "") => html`<div class="border rounded p-2">
  <div class="small text-muted">${label}</div><div class="fs-6 fw-semibold">${value}</div>
  <div class="small text-muted">${note}</div></div>`
```

```{ojs}
hash = decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1))
viewof code = Inputs.radio(codes, {
  value: codes.includes(hash) ? hash : "RX",
  label: "Contract",
  format: k => `${k}`
})
```

```{ojs}
{
  history.replaceState(null, "", `#${code}`);
  return html`<p class="small text-muted mb-2">${baskets.contracts[code].name} · data updated ${trades.updated} ·
  times as published by Eurex</p>`;
```

```{ojs}
// Today's CTD and 2nd CTD for the contract: deliverables ranked by price / CF at delivery (see the CTD page).
bk = baskets.contracts[code]
ranked = {
  const d = parseDate(bk.delivery);
  const model = setup({
    basket: bk.bonds.map(b => ({id: b.id, name: b.name, coupon: b.coupon / 100, maturity: parseDate(b.maturity),
      y0: b.yield / 100, beta: b.beta, cf: b.cf})),
    analysisDate: parseDate(bk.asOf.split("/").reverse().join("-")),
    deliveryDate: d, firstDeliveryDay: d, freq: bk.freq, cfMethod: "eurex"
  });
  return [...model.bonds].sort((a, b) => a.f0 - b.f0);
}
ctd1 = ranked[0]
ctd2 = ranked[1]
expiry = bk.delivery.slice(0, 7)
```

```{ojs}
// Shared views. All trades of a series are shown in sequence; VWAP and its running total restart each day.
withVwap = rows => {
  let pq = 0, q = 0, day = null;
  return rows.map((r, i) => {
    const d = r.t.slice(0, 10);
    if (d !== day) { pq = 0; q = 0; day = d; }
    pq += r.v * r.q; q += r.q;
    return {...r, i, day: d, time: r.t.slice(11, 16), vwap: pq / q, prev: i ? rows[i - 1].v : r.v,
      first: i === 0 || rows[i - 1].t.slice(0, 10) !== d};
  });
}

// Outliers are left out of the charts and the VWAP but kept, flagged, in the trade table.
// Stage 1 (gross misprints): more than `k` median absolute deviations, and at least `floor`, from the series median.
grossSplit = (rows, floor, k = 8) => {
  const med = d3.median(rows, r => r.v);
  const mad = d3.median(rows, r => Math.abs(r.v - med)) || 0;
  const limit = Math.max(floor, k * mad);
  return {kept: rows.filter(r => Math.abs(r.v - med) <= limit), dropped: rows.filter(r => Math.abs(r.v - med) > limit)};
}
// Stage 2 (off-market prints): more than `k` typical deviations, and at least `floor`, from that day's median.
localSplit = (rows, floor, k = 8) => {
  const dayMedian = new Map(d3.rollups(rows, g => d3.median(g, r => r.v), r => r.t.slice(0, 10)));
  const dev = r => Math.abs(r.v - dayMedian.get(r.t.slice(0, 10)));
  const limit = Math.max(floor, k * (d3.median(rows, dev) || 0));
  return {kept: rows.filter(r => dev(r) <= limit), dropped: rows.filter(r => dev(r) > limit)};
}
withOutliers = (rows, outliers) => [...rows, ...outliers.map(r => ({...r, outlier: true, time: r.t.slice(11, 16)}))]
  .sort((a, b) => a.t < b.t ? -1 : a.t > b.t ? 1 : 0)

outlierNote = (n, unit) => n ? html`<p class="small text-muted">${n} print${n > 1 ? "s" : ""} flagged as outliers
  (far from the series or that day's median) ${n > 1 ? "are" : "is"} left out of the chart and VWAP, and marked in the table below.</p>` : html``

// Stats for the latest trading day in the series.
tilesFor = (rows, unit, digits) => {
  if (!rows.length) return html`<p class="text-muted">No trades in this series.</p>`;
  const r = rows[rows.length - 1], today = rows.filter(d => d.day === r.day);
  return html`<div class="tiles">
    ${tile("Latest day", r.day, `${fmt(today.length)} trades`)}
    ${tile("Lots", fmt(d3.sum(today, d => d.q)))}
    ${tile("VWAP", `${r.vwap.toFixed(digits)} ${unit}`)}
    ${tile("Last", `${r.v.toFixed(digits)} ${unit}`, r.time)}
    ${tile("Day range", `${d3.min(today, d => d.v).toFixed(digits)} – ${d3.max(today, d => d.v).toFixed(digits)}`)}
  </div>`;
}

// Every trade in sequence across the whole history: level (waterfall or bubbles), the day's running VWAP
// (restarting each morning) and lots. Thin rules mark the start of each day. Drag to zoom, double-click to reset.
tradeChart = (rows, unit, view) => {
  if (!rows.length) return html``;
  const idx = rows.map(r => r.i);
  const starts = rows.filter(r => r.first);
  const hover = rows.map(r => `${r.day} ${r.time} · ${fmt(r.q)} lots<br>${r.v.toFixed(2)} ${unit} (${signed(r.v - r.prev, 2)})` +
    `<br>day VWAP ${r.vwap.toFixed(2)} ${unit}`);
  // VWAP line broken between days so each day's VWAP starts afresh.
  const vx = [], vy = [];
  rows.forEach((r, k) => { if (r.first && k) { vx.push(null); vy.push(null); } vx.push(r.i); vy.push(r.vwap); });
  // Label a day's first trade only when it is at least ~40px past the previous label.
  const perTrade = 820 / rows.length;
  const labelled = [];
  for (const r of starts) if (!labelled.length || (r.i - labelled[labelled.length - 1]) * perTrade >= 40) labelled.push(r.i);
  const level = view === "Waterfall"
    ? [{type: "bar", name: "Trade", x: idx, base: rows.map(r => r.prev), y: rows.map(r => (r.v - r.prev) || 1e-9),
        marker: {color: rows.map(r => r.v > r.prev ? "#38d39f" : r.v < r.prev ? "#ff6b6b" : "#5c6270")},
        hovertext: hover, hoverinfo: "text", showlegend: false},
       {type: "scatter", mode: "markers", name: "Print", x: idx, y: rows.map(r => r.v),
        marker: {symbol: "line-ew-open", size: 7, color: "#e6e9ef", line: {width: 1}}, hoverinfo: "skip", showlegend: false}]
    : [{type: "scatter", mode: "markers", name: "Trade (size = lots)", x: idx, y: rows.map(r => r.v),
        marker: {size: rows.map(r => r.q), sizemode: "area", sizeref: 2 * d3.max(rows, r => r.q) / 22 ** 2, sizemin: 2,
          color: "rgba(96,165,250,0.35)", line: {color: "#60a5fa", width: 1}},
        hovertext: hover, hoverinfo: "text"}];
  return plot([
    ...level,
    {type: "scatter", mode: "lines", name: "Day VWAP", x: vx, y: vy, line: {color: "#a78bfa", width: 2, shape: "hv"},
      connectgaps: false, hoverinfo: "skip"},
    {type: "bar", name: "Lots", x: idx, y: rows.map(r => r.q), yaxis: "y2", marker: {color: "rgba(124,92,255,0.35)"},
      hovertext: hover, hoverinfo: "text", showlegend: false}
  ], {
    bargap: 0.15,
    xaxis: {tickvals: labelled, ticktext: labelled.map(i => rows[i].day.slice(5)), range: [-0.5, rows.length - 0.5], showgrid: false},
    yaxis: {domain: [0.3, 1], title: {text: unit}},
    yaxis2: {domain: [0, 0.22], title: {text: "Lots"}},
    shapes: starts.slice(1).map(r => ({type: "line", x0: r.i - 0.5, x1: r.i - 0.5, y0: 0, y1: 1, yref: "paper",
      line: {color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)", width: 1}}))
  }, 460);
}

tradeTable = (rows, cols) => html`<div class="table-responsive trade-table"><table class="table table-sm small">
  <thead><tr><th></th>${cols.map(c => html`<th class="text-end">${c[0]}</th>`)}</tr></thead>
  <tbody>${[...rows].reverse().map(r => {
    const tr = html`<tr><td>${r.outlier ? html`<span class="outlier-tag">outlier</span>` : ""}</td>
      ${cols.map(c => html`<td class="text-end">${c[1](r)}</td>`)}</tr>`;
    if (r.outlier) tr.className = "outlier-row";
    return tr;
  })}</tbody>
</table></div>`
```

### Basis trades (EFP)

```{ojs}
viewof bondPick = Inputs.radio(["CTD", "2nd CTD"], {value: "CTD", label: "Bond",
  format: k => `${k}: ${(k === "CTD" ? ctd1 : ctd2).name}`})
viewof efpView = Inputs.radio(["Waterfall", "Bubbles"], {value: "Waterfall", label: "Trade view"})
```

```{ojs}
efpBond = bondPick === "CTD" ? ctd1 : ctd2
// Gross basis in cents (0.01 price points): cash price − futures price × conversion factor.
efpGross = grossSplit(trades.efp
  .filter(r => r.c === code && r.x === expiry && r.isin === efpBond.id)
  .map(r => ({...r, v: (r.cash - r.f * efpBond.cf) * 100})), 25)
efpLocal = localSplit(efpGross.kept, 2)
efpRows = withVwap(efpLocal.kept)
efpTable = withOutliers(efpRows, [...efpGross.dropped, ...efpLocal.dropped])
```

```{ojs}
html`<p class="small text-muted">${efpBond.name} (${efpBond.id}), CF ${efpBond.cf.toFixed(6)}.
Gross basis = cash price − futures × CF, in cents (0.01 points).</p>`
```

```{ojs}
tilesFor(efpRows, "c", 1)
```

```{ojs}
  ["Cash", r => r.cash.toFixed(4)], ["Gross basis (c)", r => r.v.toFixed(1)], ["Day VWAP (c)", r => r.outlier ? "–" : r.vwap.toFixed(1)]
])
```

### Invoice spreads (EFS)

```{ojs}
viewof efsType = Inputs.radio(["Matched to CTD", "Other tenors"], {value: "Matched to CTD", label: "Swap",
  format: k => k === "Matched to CTD" ? "Matched to CTD (invoice spread)" : "Other tenors"})
viewof efsLeg = Inputs.radio(["Lower", "Upper"], {value: "Lower", label: "Cluster",
  format: k => k === "Lower" ? "Lower (likely €STR OIS)" : "Upper (likely 6m Euribor)", disabled: efsType !== "Matched to CTD"})
viewof efsView = Inputs.radio(["Waterfall", "Bubbles"], {value: "Waterfall", label: "Trade view"})
```

```{ojs}
// Invoice spread in bp: swap fixed rate − CTD yield implied by the futures price (forward price = futures × CF).
// Matched EFS: swap starts around delivery and ends within 45 days of the CTD's maturity.
// The rest are swaps of other tenors (e.g. spot-starting 10-year swaps), shown separately.
isMatched = r => Math.abs(parseDate(`${r.e.slice(0, 4)}-${r.e.slice(4, 6)}-${r.e.slice(6)}`) - ctd1.maturity) <= 45 * 864e5
  && r.s >= bk.delivery.replaceAll("-", "").slice(0, 6) + "01"
efsGross = grossSplit(trades.efs
  .filter(r => r.c === code && r.x === expiry && isMatched(r) === (efsType === "Matched to CTD"))
  .map(r => {
    const y = yieldFromPrice(ctd1.price, r.f * ctd1.cf);
    return {...r, y: y * 100, v: (r.rate / 100 - y) * 10000};
  }), 40)
// Matched EFS print in two clusters ~15–30 bp apart on the same swap dates, consistent with €STR OIS vs 6m Euribor
// floating legs (the trade file has no index field). Split them with a 1-D two-means so each VWAP is like-for-like.
twoMeans = values => {
  let lo = d3.quantile(values, 0.1), hi = d3.quantile(values, 0.9);
  for (let k = 0; k < 20; k++) {
    const mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
    lo = d3.mean(values.filter(v => v <= mid)) ?? lo;
    hi = d3.mean(values.filter(v => v > mid)) ?? hi;
  }
  return {lo, hi, cut: (lo + hi) / 2, split: hi - lo >= 8};
}
efsClusters = twoMeans(efsGross.kept.map(r => r.v))
efsAll = efsType === "Matched to CTD" && efsClusters.split
  ? efsGross.kept.filter(r => (r.v > efsClusters.cut) === (efsLeg === "Upper"))
  : efsGross.kept
efsLocal = localSplit(efsAll, 3)
efsRows = withVwap(efsLocal.kept)
efsTable = withOutliers(efsRows, [...efsGross.dropped, ...efsLocal.dropped])
```

```{ojs}
html`<p class="small text-muted">${efsType === "Matched to CTD"
  ? html`Invoice spread = fixed rate of a forward swap from delivery to the ${ctd1.name} maturity − the CTD yield implied by the
    futures price (forward price = futures × ${ctd1.cf.toFixed(6)}, settling ${bk.delivery}), in bp.`
  : html`EFS against swaps that are not matched to the CTD (other start or end dates, e.g. spot-starting 10-year swaps):
    swap rate − futures-implied ${ctd1.name} yield, in bp. The tenor mismatch adds curve slope, so compare like tenors.`}
Positive: swap above the futures-implied yield.
${efsType === "Matched to CTD" && efsClusters.split ? `Matched trades fall in two clusters (centres ${efsClusters.lo.toFixed(1)} and
${efsClusters.hi.toFixed(1)} bp), most likely €STR OIS and 6m Euribor swaps; Eurex's file does not say which, so this split is inferred.` : ""}</p>`
```

```{ojs}
tilesFor(efsRows, "bp", 1)
```

```{ojs}
  ["Implied CTD yield", r => r.y.toFixed(3) + "%"], ["Swap rate", r => r.rate.toFixed(4) + "%"],
```

### Monthly open interest

```{ojs}
FLOWS = ["New longs", "Short covering", "New shorts", "Long liquidation"]
FLOW_STYLE = ({
  "New longs": ["rgba(56,211,159,0.85)", "#ffffff"],
  "Short covering": ["rgba(56,211,159,0.28)", "#a7f3d0"],
  "New shorts": ["rgba(255,107,107,0.85)", "#ffffff"],
  "Long liquidation": ["rgba(255,107,107,0.28)", "#fecaca"]
})
flowStyle = f => FLOW_STYLE[f] ?? ["rgba(255,255,255,0.05)", "#a0a7b4"]
badge = f => {
  const el = document.createElement("span");
  el.className = "flow-badge";
  [el.style.background, el.style.color] = flowStyle(f);
  el.textContent = f ?? "n/a";
  return el;
}
monthLabel = m => new Date(`${m}-01T00:00:00Z`).toLocaleString("en-GB", {month: "short", year: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC"}).replace(/^Sept/, "Sep")
isExpiry = m => ["03", "06", "09", "12"].includes(m.slice(5))
compact = d3.format(".3~s")
oiMonths = [...new Set(codes.flatMap(k => oiData.contracts[k].months.filter(m => m.oi != null).map(m => m.month)))].sort().reverse()
oiSeries = (key, hoverExtra) => codes.map((k, i) => {
  const c = oiData.contracts[k];
  return {name: k, x: c.months.map(m => `${m.month}-01`), y: c.months.map(m => m[key]),
    marker: {color: COLORS[i % COLORS.length]}, line: {color: COLORS[i % COLORS.length], width: 2},
    customdata: c.months.map(m => [monthLabel(m.month), m.flow ?? "n/a", m.dYieldBp == null ? "–" : signed(m.dYieldBp)]),
    hovertemplate: `<b>${k}</b> %{customdata[0]}<br>${hoverExtra}<br>%{customdata[1]} · Δyield %{customdata[2]} bp<extra></extra>`};
})
oiLayout = (title, extra = {}) => ({hovermode: "closest", xaxis: {type: "date", tickformat: "%b %y"},
  yaxis: {title: {text: title}, tickformat: "~s"}, ...extra})
```

```{ojs}
html`<div class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-2">${FLOWS.map(badge)}${badge(null)}</div>
<p class="small text-muted">All contracts, every month available. Click legend entries to hide or show contracts;
drag to zoom, double-click to reset. Rising OI with futures up (yields down) = new longs; OI up, futures down = new shorts;
OI down, futures up = short covering; OI down, futures down = long liquidation.</p>`
```

```{ojs}
html`<div class="table-responsive oi-table"><table class="table table-sm align-middle small flow-table">
  <thead><tr><th>Month</th>${codes.map(k => html`<th class="text-end">${k}</th>`)}</tr></thead>
  <tbody>${oiMonths.map(mo => html`<tr>
    <td>${monthLabel(mo)}${isExpiry(mo) ? "*" : ""}</td>
    ${codes.map(k => {
      const c = oiData.contracts[k], i = c.months.findIndex(m => m.month === mo), m = c.months[i], prev = c.months[i - 1];
      if (!m || m.oi == null) return html`<td class="text-end text-muted">–</td>`;
      const td = html`<td class="text-end"><div>${compact(m.oi)}</div>
        <div class="oi-sub">${prev?.oi ? signed(100 * m.dOI / prev.oi, 1) + "%" : "–"}</div></td>`;
      [td.style.background, td.style.color] = flowStyle(m.flow);
      td.title = `${k} ${monthLabel(mo)}: OI ${fmt(m.oi)}, ΔOI ${m.dOI == null ? "–" : signed(m.dOI)}, volume ${m.volume == null ? "–" : fmt(m.volume)}, ` +
        `Δyield ${signed(m.dYieldBp)} bp, ${m.flow ?? "no flow label"}`;
      return td;
    })}
  </tr>`)}</tbody>
</table></div>
<p class="small text-muted">Each cell: month-end open interest and its change on the month, shaded by flow. Hover a cell for details.
* Expiry month: month-end OI is measured after the roll, so falls can reflect positions not rolled.
Months missing for every contract are not available from Eurex.</p>`
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Data and method

- **EFP and EFS trades:** Eurex [EFP-Fin](https://www.eurex.com/ex-en/data/trading-files/efpf) and
  [EFS](https://www.eurex.com/ex-en/data/trading-files/efs) trade files. Eurex lists only about 20 trading days, so every
  file is archived locally and the data refreshed hourly. Only the front contract (December 2026) is shown.
- **CTD and 2nd CTD:** deliverables ranked by price / conversion factor at today's yields, as on the
  [CTD page](ctd.html). EFPs against any other bond are excluded.
- **Gross basis** = cash price − futures × CF (cents). It includes carry to delivery, so it drifts down towards the
  net basis as delivery approaches.
- **Invoice spread** = swap fixed rate − the CTD yield implied by the futures price, treating futures × CF as the
  CTD's forward price on the delivery date. Swap tenors in an EFS vary, so compare spreads across trades with similar tenors.
- **Monthly open interest:** [Eurex monthly statistics](https://www.eurex.com/ex-en/data/statistics/monthly-statistics),
  with yields from the Bundesbank (Germany, month-end) and FRED (France and Italy, monthly averages).
:::
